participant_id.Description: BIDS label from the release folder name (EC <n> -> EC<n>)

age.Description: Age in years (Table S1, 'Modified Heights Stimulus' columns, Yilmaz Balban et al. 2021 Curr Biol 31:601-612.e3, doi:10.1016/j.cub.2020.11.035)

sex.Description: Gender (Table S1). Note: the Results text refers to EC 200 as 'her' while Table S1 lists EC 200 as M; the table value is kept.

group.Description: Participant group: patients with treatment-resistant epilepsy implanted with intracranial electrodes for localisation of seizure foci at the UCSF Hospital (under Dr. Edward Chang's care); included if they had electrodes in the regions of interest (insula, OFC) and were willing to do the VR task (Yilmaz Balban et al. 2021 Curr Biol 31:601-612.e3, doi:10.1016/j.cub.2020.11.035, STAR Methods)

Levels.epilepsy_patient: patient with treatment-resistant epilepsy implanted with intracranial electrodes (UCSF)

stai_state.Description: STAI State anxiety score (Table S1, 'STAI Score (State, Trait)')

stai_trait.Description: STAI Trait anxiety score (Table S1, 'STAI Score (State, Trait)')

n_electrodes_in_table.Description: Rows in the electrode location table of the release

implant_type.Description: Electrode type(s) in the release electrode table (<EC n>_TDT_elecs_all_warped.mat, column type)

n_electrode_leads.Description: Number of electrode leads (distinct electrode names without contact number) in the release electrode table, excluding NaN placeholder rows

implanted_hemisphere.Description: Implanted hemisphere derived from the release electrode table: anatomical labels (rh / Right-) and positive x of the warped coordinates for all leads (EC205: the deep tips of two right-sided leads reach the midline, one contact labelled ctx_lh_G_rectus). Not stated in the paper text.

paper_regions_of_interest.Description: Regions analysed in the paper for this patient: electrodes in the insula (EC 192, EC 205) and in the orbitofrontal cortex (EC 200, EC 205) (Yilmaz Balban et al. 2021 Curr Biol 31:601-612.e3, doi:10.1016/j.cub.2020.11.035, Results)

n_visual_scans_heights.Description: Number of visual scanning episodes during the modified heights stimulus reported in the paper (3 from EC 192, 2 from EC 205; EC 200 had none) (Yilmaz Balban et al. 2021 Curr Biol 31:601-612.e3, doi:10.1016/j.cub.2020.11.035, Results)

tdt_export_year_month.Description: Year and month in the 'Created on' header of this patient's TDTData_*.mat iEEG files in the release (MATLAB export date; the recordings took place on or before it). The recording dates are not documented. Day intentionally omitted.
